title: Nail disorders
claims: Subungual haematoma is a deep red or black discolouration under the toenail plate, often following trauma.
In the acute phase it can be very tender with inflammation of the surrounding skin; after the acute phase there is often no pain.
There is a clear demarcation line where new healthy nail grows, and it can take up to a year for a new healthy nail to regrow.
No management is required for subungual haematoma.
Patients with nail conditions who have diabetes (moderate or high risk on screening) and/or peripheral vascular disease should be referred urgently to podiatry.
Suspected subungual melanomas should be referred urgently to dermatology.

claimVerification.note: Subungal haematoma：甲板下深红/黑，常继发于外伤。
急性期触痛、周围皮肤炎症；急性期后常无痛。
可见新甲生长的分界线，新甲再生可达一年。
糖尿病中/高危或 PVD 的甲病患者应紧急转足病科。
疑似甲下黑色素瘤应紧急转皮肤科。
